intro: Meet hundreds of people at a conference and remember every one of them.
pitch: Chatsoon is a networking CRM built for events. Share your profile with a QR code, capture the people you meet in seconds, and keep every conversation going long after the event ends.

hero.eyebrow: The networking CRM built for events
hero.ctaCaption: Free, and ready on the web today.
hero.comingSoon: Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play

mock.contactFootnote: Filled in from a card photo

features.title: Every hello, ready to follow up
features.subtitle: Built for the busiest week of your year: conferences, meetups and trade shows.

items.title: Share your digital business card
items.body: Show your QR code. Anyone can scan it and connect with you, even if they don't have the app. Their details land straight in your contacts.

items.title: Scan cards and badges with AI
items.body: Snap a business card or event badge and Chatsoon fills in the details for you. Scan QR codes from Telegram, LinkedIn, X or a digital business card. Or type a name and move on.

items.title: Organise everyone
items.body: Tag people as sponsors, investors, advisors, collaborators or anything you like. Add notes, set priority, and group contacts by the event where you met.

items.title: Find anyone fast
items.body: Search by name, company, tag or notes. Tap to message on Telegram, email, LinkedIn or X.

items.title: Private by design
items.body: Your notes and tags are yours alone. Connections only see your public profile. Export your data or delete your account anytime.

items.title: Show your QR
items.body: Open My QR at the event. It's your profile, ready to scan.

items.title: They scan it
items.body: With Chatsoon, or just their phone camera. No app needed.

items.title: Follow up
items.body: Their details land in your contacts, ready for a note and a tag.

closing.title: Meet people. Follow up.
closing.body: Chatsoon is coming soon to the App Store and Google Play. Start on the web today and take it to your next event.
